description: Unsigned transactions for one credit risk action, read against the contract state: cover (offer to cover a tranche in USDC at a yearly premium: allowance, then the offer), withdraw_offer, collect (premium and interest), sell (list a position at a price), unlist, buy (allowance, then the purchase at the listed price at most) or release (take back the guarantee once the portfolio has ended). To be signed and sent in order by the user's or the agent's own wallet; nothing is signed or sent by this server.

amount.description: USDC covered, digits with an optional decimal point (cover)

positionId.description: Position id (collect, sell, unlist, buy, release)

premium.description: Yearly premium asked, in percent, for example 11.5 (cover)

wallet.description: Address of the wallet that will sign and send

name: sjothr_risk_prepare
title: Prepare a credit risk action
